analyses.title: Ganetespib response across cancer cell lines
analyses.question: How did cancer cell lines respond to ganetespib in the PRISM dose-response screen?
analyses.summary: Across 452 cell lines, the median fitted viability AUC was 0.687 (IQR 0.609–0.804). The median shifted from 0.687 to 0.635 when restricted to curves with R² ≥ 0.5 (296/452 lines). Tissue medians are descriptive.

source.citation: Broad DepMap et al., PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 Dataset, v4; doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.9393293.v4

analyses.method: MTS010 ganetespib curves across eight doses (0.000153–2.5 µM). PR500 would take precedence for a cell line present in both assay panels, following DepMap staff guidance; no STR-valid ganetespib cell line was duplicated. One finite AUC per STR-validated cell line was retained. Median intervals use 1,000 bootstrap resamples of cell lines within each official primary tissue; tissue rows require at least 10 lines.

effect.label: Median fitted viability AUC
effect.direction: Lower fitted viability AUC indicates more inhibition across the tested dose range.

analyses.n_definition: Distinct DepMap cell lines with finite ganetespib MTS010 AUC and passed STR profiling after PR500 duplicate precedence. Each cell line counts once; dose points and technical repeats do not increase n.
analyses.limitation: Descriptive response only. Ganetespib is a broad HSP90 inhibitor, so these curves cannot identify an HSP90 isoform interaction or client. The source README describes a convergence flag that is absent from the released curve CSV; a separate R² sensitivity row shows the effect of filtering fitted curves. Tissue medians are not comparative tests.

results.label: All eligible cell lines
results.caveat: Descriptive median; tissue medians were not tested against one another.

results.label: Curves with R² ≥ 0.5
results.caveat: R² filter is a sensitivity check; flat response curves may have low R².

analyses.title: Ganetespib response ranks across two PRISM screens
analyses.question: Do cell lines retain a similar response order in the MTS010 rerun and original HTS002 screen?
analyses.summary: Among 442 shared lines, AUC response ranks had Spearman ρ = 0.510 (95% bootstrap CI 0.435–0.585); the screens used different dose ranges.

source.citation: Broad DepMap et al., PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 Dataset, v4; doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.9393293.v4

analyses.method: Spearman correlation of AUC ranks for STR-validated DepMap cell lines present in both ganetespib screens. MTS010 uses PR500 precedence for duplicate lines; HTS002 duplicate lines are median-collapsed. Interval from 1,000 cell-line bootstrap resamples.

effect.label: Spearman correlation of response ranks
effect.direction: Positive values mean more similar cell-line response ranks across screens.

analyses.n_definition: Distinct STR-validated DepMap cell lines with finite ganetespib AUC in both HTS002 and MTS010, counted once.
analyses.limitation: HTS002 tested 0.00061034–10 µM whereas MTS010 tested 0.000153–2.5 µM. Their AUC levels are not directly comparable. These screens test the same compound and are not an independent mechanism validation.

results.label: Shared cell lines
results.caveat: Different dose ranges; compare ranks, not absolute AUC.
